verdict.rationale: The gateway exposes a lot programmatically: inference through a unified, OpenAI-compatible API, per-request routing, timeouts, caching and BYOK via providerOptions.gateway, and an unauthenticated models endpoint with pricing. A Vercel OpenAPI spec is also published. However, nothing documents that management features shown in the UI have API equivalents; the Logs page search and export, the Requests and Usage dashboards, and budget setting are all described as dashboard features. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API endpoints for logs, usage metrics, budgets and API-key management, confirmation that the OpenAPI spec covers AI Gateway admin operations, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can use `order`, `only`, and `sort` in `providerOptions.gateway` to control which providers handle your requests, in what order, and how they are ranked.
Query the models endpoint directly to get a JSON list of all available models with pricing and capabilities
you can pass provider credentials on a per-request basis using the byok option in providerOptions.gateway
